items.title: Anthropic raises $65B, nears $1T valuation ahead of IPO, topping OpenAI as most valuable AI startup
items.summary: Anthropic closed a $65 billion Series H funding round at a $965 billion post-money valuation, co-led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, Sequoia Capital, and others. The round includes $15B from hyperscalers including Amazon, and strategic investments from Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron. Anthropic also released Claude Opus 4.8 with improved agentic capabilities, positioning the company for a potential IPO.

items.title: AI coding startup Cognition raises $1B at $26B valuation for Devin AI platform
items.summary: Cognition, the maker of AI coding assistant Devin, raised $1 billion in a round co-led by Lux Capital, General Catalyst, and 8VC, with participation from Ribbit Capital, Atreides Management, and Peter Thiel's Founders Fund. The startup's valuation jumped to $26 billion as enterprise demand for AI-powered software development tools continues to surge.

items.title: Silicon Valley pivots to Physical AI: OpenAI declares robotics next frontier, Figure AI humanoid livestream goes viral
items.summary: The biggest AI players are racing into humanoid robotics. OpenAI CEO Sam Altman declared robotics the company's next frontier. Nvidia announced a standard humanoid robot blueprint at GTC Taipei. Figure AI's humanoid livestream of package sorting drew millions of viewers, and the startup signed a commercial agreement with Catalyst Brands (JCPenney, Aeropostale) to deploy humanoids in logistics networks.
